maddeler.e:
أضطرب (form VIII)
# أَضْطَرِبُ (ʔaḍṭaribu) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ri.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# أَضْطَرِبَ (ʔaḍṭariba) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ri.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# أَضْطَرِبْ (ʔaḍṭarib) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.rib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
